import (
{{- if .Imports}}

	    "{{.Import}}"
    {{- end }}

	"github.com/xiexiao/golua/lua"

{{- if .StructName}}
    const luaMT_{{.StructName}} = "_{{.PkgName}}.luaMT_{{.StructName}}"

    func Lua{{.StructName}}Init(L *lua.State) int {
	    L.InitMetaTable(luaMT_{{.StructName}}, lua_{{.StructName}}Funcs)
	    return 0
    }
{{- end }}

{{- if .Funcs }}
    {{- range .Funcs}}
        {{ template "func" .}}
    {{- end}}
{{- end }}

{{- if .TypeFuncs}}
    {{- range .TypeFuncs}}
        {{ template "func" .}}
    {{- end}}
{{- end}}

{{- if .Fields}}
    {{- range .Fields}}
        {{ template "func_field" .}}
    {{- end}}
{{- end}}

{{- if .StructName}}
    var lua_{{.StructName}}Funcs = map[string]lua.LuaGoFunction {
    {{- if .Fields}}
        {{- range .Fields }}
	        "_{{.Name}}": lua_{{.StructName}}{{.FieldName}},
        {{- end }}
    {{- end }}

    {{- if .TypeFuncs}}
        {{- range .TypeFuncs }}
	        "{{.Name}}": {{.FuncPrefix}}{{.StructName}}{{.FuncName}},
        {{- end }}
    {{- end }}
    }
{{- end }}
